key_expressions: Do you have any rooms available?,

A: Hi there, do you have any rooms available for this weekend?
I'm planning to check in on Saturday afternoon.
Do you have a double room where I can stay comfortably?
B: Hello! Sure, just tell me your dates and I’ll check for you.
Yes, that time works! You can also choose your bed type.
Yes, a double room is available. Would you like me to book it for you?

A: Do you also have rooms with breakfast included?
That sounds nice! It would be more convenient with breakfast.
Could you tell me how much the rate is?
B: Yes, we do. The breakfast option is quite popular.
Right, and the breakfast time is flexible, so it’s easy to enjoy.
For a double room, the rate is 90,000 won per night.

A: What time does check-in start?
Great, that works well with my arrival time.
Is it okay if I arrive a bit late?
B: You can check in from 3 p.m.
Perfect, then you can come without rushing.
Sure, just let us know in advance and it’s no problem.

A: Do you have a parking area I can use?
Wow, that’s great that it’s free!
So I just need to ask at check-in, right?
B: Yes, guests can use the parking lot free of charge.
Exactly! Most guests find it very convenient.
Yes, the front desk will guide you when you check in.

A: Do you have any rooms with large windows?
Oh, that sounds perfect! Good lighting is important to me.
I'd like to reserve that room, please.
B: Yes, we have one room with a nice view left.
Right, it gets a lot of sunlight. Guests really like it.
Great! I’ll book that room for you.

A: Do you happen to have smoking rooms?
Ah, I see. A non-smoking room is totally fine!
If possible, a room by the window would be even nicer.
B: We currently operate as a fully non-smoking property.
Yes! Many guests prefer the non-smoking rooms because they're cleaner.
Sure, I'll try to assign you the best available room.

A: Is it possible to stay with a pet?
Oh, so only small dogs are allowed!
Then as long as I follow the rules, it's okay, right?
B: Yes, small dogs are allowed.
Right! And the additional fee isn’t high.
Yes, just follow the guidelines we explain at check-in.

A: Can I pay on site as well?
Great! Then I’ll pay when I check in.
Could you also tell me about your cancellation policy?
B: Yes, you can choose either on-site payment or prepayment.
Yes! That tends to be the most convenient.
You can cancel for free up to one day before your stay.

A: Does each room have a private bathroom?
Oh, a private bathroom is perfect.
Amenities are included as well, right?
B: Yes, every room comes with a private bathroom.
Yes! Most guests find it very comfortable.
Yes, the basic amenities are all provided.

A: Could you confirm the reservation for me?
Great! Getting the confirmation by text would be helpful.
Thank you! I’m looking forward to my stay.
B: Yes, I’ll confirm it right now.
I’ll send you a text message. Please tell us when you arrive!
Have a wonderful trip!
